findings: Naming contract met (R2, R3, S1-S3): the six assets exist in assets/. player.glb has six separate parts: torso, head, arm_left, arm_right, leg_left and leg_right. Each other asset has a node with its contracted name.

Dimensions and look match the spec: ground block 2x2x1, platform 2x1.2x0.4, spike about 0.8 tall, coin disc of radius 0.3 with its faces along Z, pole 2.2 tall with a triangular flag, player 1.8 tall with limb pivots at the top ends. The palette is built with bpy Principled BSDF only.

S6 holds: blender/ has no import_scene, image.load or bpy.data.images.load, and no binary or bytecode files. `npm test` passes 6/6 (S1-S6). The lineup render shows all six assets in a row.
